title: The Hello Kitty Slumber Party for Little Girls
description: A Hello Kitty slumber party for little girls from Sam's Club: a cloud faux fur throw, a cloud pillow, a body pillow, a crochet kit, a sketch and jewelry studio and a tray of Hello Kitty cupcakes.
intro: A sleepover for four little girls sounded adorable right up until I pictured four little girls with nothing to do at 9 pm. So the whole night got a theme. Hello Kitty everything: a fuzzy throw to pile on, pillows big enough to fight over, a crochet kit and a sketch and jewelry studio to keep hands busy, and thirty cupcakes because I am not a monster. Nobody slept, everybody made a bracelet, and I was the coolest mom on the street for exactly one night.
